description: Endpoints read by the Editor Dashboard Workspace. Mirrors the endpoints declared in scripts/toolkit/lib/editor-workspace.js; the test suite fails if they drift.

operations.name: listArticleEditorialWorkflow
operations.description: Articles with editorial stage and deadline for the Editorial Calendar.

operations.name: listInvestigationEditorialWorkflow
operations.description: Investigations with workflow stage and deadline for the Editorial Calendar.

operations.name: listInvestigationReviewQueue
operations.description: Investigations awaiting an editorial publish decision. Editor and admin only.

operations.description: Correction and flag records, used by the Flagged Articles view.

operations.name: listEditors
operations.description: Editor accounts (id and name only) that articles can be assigned to. Editor and admin only.

operations.description: Sets or clears the editor assigned to an article. Editor and admin only; the assignee must be an editor account.
